offence_note: Offence not shown; animal ownership prohibition under s. 447.1
sentence_quote: I found no error of principle or law in the sentence imposed by the learned trial judge on the basis of the evidence before her at the time of sentencing.
note: Appeal of animal prohibition order only; fresh evidence application invited.

offence_note: Robbery with restricted firearm, firearms offences
sentence_quote: Nor is the total sentence imposed of six years manifestly excessive.
note: Pre-sentence credit at 1.5:1 given by trial judge; mandatory minimum upheld.

offence_note: Two assaults and possession of stolen car
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal but I would dismiss the appeal.
note: Sentences 12, 9 and 30 months consecutive; 36 months credit.

offence_note: 24 break and enters, robbery, confinement, assault, threatening, possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted and the appeal is allowed, but only to the extent of removing the victim fine surcharge.
note: 15-year total stands; only victim surcharge removed.

offence_note: Sexual assault of 17-year-old student by school custodian
sentence_quote: I therefore sentence Mr. D. to a 2 year period of incarceration as per the joint recommendation.
systemic_quote: In my view, the Gladue factors here are significant, ranging from alcohol abuse and family violence to suicide and the injecting of solvents by Mr. D. as a youth.
note: Joint recommendation accepted; s. 161 order declined; s. 109 for 10 years, SOIRA 20 years.

sentence_quote: I sentence you to eight years for this wrongful death. You will receive double credit for the 17 months of incarceration you have served on remand.
note: Double credit for 17 months remand; lifetime s. 109 ban.

offence_note: Possession of prohibited or restricted firearm with ammunition
sentence_quote: With respect to the offence under s.95(1) of the Criminal Code I hereby sentence you to a period of three years in a federal institution.
note: Joint recommendation at mandatory minimum; victim surcharge waived; lifetime s. 109.

offence_note: Armed break-in, death threats, aggravated assault on spouse, assault on child
sentence_quote: the sentence is set aside and a term of 3.5 years (in addition to 9 months pre-trial custody) is substituted therefor
note: Crown appeal; 12 months raised to five years total; credit inferred as 18 months for 9 months.

offence_note: Offences not shown; sentence appeal on pre-sentence credit only
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted and the credit to be given to his three year sentence is fixed at 27.5 months for a net sentence of 8.5 months.
note: Credit increased by two months; offences not stated.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm, common assault, obstructing police
sentence_quote: I am of the view that the sentence of two years imprisonment was entirely fit.
note: Concurrent six months on the other two counts.

sentence_quote: I sentence you to life imprisonment for the second degree murder of Ms. Williams. I have concluded that a period of parole ineligibility of ten years is appropriate.
note: Cree status member; grandparents attended residential schools but no Gladue weighing shown.

offence_note: Occupant of vehicle with firearm; carrying concealed weapon
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence granted but the appeal is dismissed per reasons for judgment of Saunders and Bourgeois, JJ.A.; Farrar, J.A. dissenting.
note: 72 months on s. 94(1), 25 months concurrent on s. 90(1); co-accused Smith sentenced separately.
